response.sql:
WITH matched_snapshots AS (
  SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, sf.instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
), units AS (
  SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS ownership
  FROM matched_snapshots
  WHERE ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist
), mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(ownership) AS baseline
  FROM units
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ownership) AS avg_ownership
  FROM units
)
SELECT
  AVG(u.ownership) AS avg_kept_ownership,
  AVG(u.ownership / mb.baseline) AS avg_ownership_to_mix_baseline,
  AVG(u.ownership - o.avg_ownership) AS avg_excess_overall
FROM units AS u
JOIN mix_baselines AS mb ON mb.ordertypedist = u.ordertypedist
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE u.ownership > o.avg_ownership;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions without any matched sentiment snapshots do not form units; AVG ignores missing institutional ownership, and units whose snapshots all have missing ownership are excluded because their ownership is NULL.
